description: Marks a knowledge entry's newest version as possibly out of date, with a note of what you found instead (on the business's site, in a document, from the person), so every agent and the person see it and the person can check and fix it. The entry is still used and nothing is overwritten; confirm_knowledge or any new version clears the flag. When you know the right text and the person agrees, change it with update_knowledge instead. Send the newest version you read; if a newer version was saved since, nothing is flagged and the answer is version_moved with the newest number.

knowledge_id.description: The entry (list_knowledge and search_knowledge give ids).

note.description: What you found instead and where, in a sentence or two, such as: The site's contact page says we open at 10.

project_id.description: The project the entry is in. May be left out: the entry's id finds its own project or the workspace.

version.description: The entry's newest version, the one that may be out of date (read_knowledge gives it).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: flag_knowledge_out_of_date
title: Flag a knowledge entry as out of date
